messages:
Alex: need a 2-hour background for an indie sci-fi novella read tonight. not cinematic, more intimate. recs?
Priya: slow cinematic folk, like Nick Drake but with subtle synth pads.
Jonah: check out 'Mount Eerie' quieter albums. very paper-and-ink vibe.
Maya: for something more propulsive but not distracting, try 'S U R V I V E' (Stranger Things folks) earlier stuff.
Alex: ooh good. any movie/short show rec that pairs with that mood?
Priya: short film: 'La Jetee' if you want time-loop mood without long runtime.
Jonah: episode pick: "San Junipero" from Black Mirror if you want bittersweet and compact.
Maya: book rec: 'All Systems Red' for light sci-fi + snark while reading, pretty quick.
Alex: love these. Poll time: which soundtrack vibe should I build (react :one: :two: :three:)?
PollBot: Poll created by Alex: "Indie-sci-fi reading soundtrack"  1️ Nick Drake & modern folk; 2️ Mount Eerie / lo-fi folk; 3️ Minimal synth + soft percussion (S U R V I V E style). Ends in 3h.
Priya: voted :one:.
Jonah: voted :two:.
Maya: voted :three:.
Alex: voted :three:. thanks all — I'll post the playlist link after I stitch it together :headphones:
Maya: report-back thread when you do, want to steal it for weekend reading.
Jonah: seconded.
Priya: and add La Jetee link too, perfect double feature.
